title: Adversarial evidence and draft review
launch_mode: Explicit user run; no scheduler or upload listener installed

table_columns.label: Issue type
table_columns.description: Support, quotation, calculation, scope, contrary evidence, ambiguity or source gap.

table_columns.label: Materiality
table_columns.description: Narrative significance with rationale, not a measured probability.

table_columns.label: Observed problem
table_columns.description: Specific defect or bounded no-issue observation.

table_columns.label: Counterargument
table_columns.description: Supported contrary reading, separately labeled from a hypothetical.

table_columns.label: Proposed correction
table_columns.description: Exact edit, deletion or source request.

table_columns.label: Review disposition
table_columns.description: Unresolved, proposed, verified corrected or no material issue observed.

actions.label: Run scoped analysis
actions.requires: Verified host agent and source adapters

actions.label: Open source
actions.requires: Authorized source resolver and safe viewer

actions.label: Export draft table
actions.requires: Bound artifact writer with source rights and spreadsheet-cell sanitization

accessibility: Semantic table with keyboard-accessible source links
Status labels in text, not color alone
Announce progress and errors; preserve focus when results refresh
host_integration_note: UI contract only. Reuse the platform shell and tested components; paths, handlers, server DTOs and persistence require verified host integration.
